messages:
oliver: Quick sync — GlobalPaymentsEU asked for a 14-day POC with strict EU processing. They want: per-region sub-processor inventory, an explicit routing policy that prevents any non-EU egress unless approved, HSM KMS option, and a clear price diff: short Dedicated pool vs hosted w/ EU-preferred routing. Also flagged security Q10 about traces leaving EU. cc @mina @sophia

mina: Noted. Can infra size if we get SAML org id + steady/spike rps and avg token length. Also need to know whether they require in-region Datadog or will accept our managed EU metrics stack.

oliver: SAML org id: GPEU-554. Baseline: 35 rps, spikes to 240 rps (bursts ~30s). Avg sequence ~520 tokens, occasional long sessions ~1500 tokens. HSM: they wrote "preferred" but will confirm.
